_serena_note: Serena is project-specific — add it directly to the project's .claude/mcp.json (see below). Do NOT enable globally; it requires --project-dir pointing to the actual codebase.

serena.description: Semantic code indexing — symbol lookup, reference finding, ~70% token reduction for large codebases. Run onboarding once: ask Claude to 'onboard this project with Serena'.

_comments.setup: Run 'node scripts/setup-mcp.js' to inject credentials from .env
_comments.usage: Copy servers from mcp-servers.with_creds.json to ~/.claude.json mcpServers section
_comments.env_vars: Edit .env file with your actual credentials
_comments.disabling: Use disabledMcpServers array in project config to disable per-project
_comments.context_warning: Keep under 10 MCPs enabled to preserve context window
